      public List<Order> loadAll(List<Table> tables, List<Dish> dishes, List<Menu> menus)
      Loads all orders with their items from the database.
      Parameters:
      tables - In-memory table catalog to resolve table references.
      dishes - In-memory dish catalog to resolve order items.
      menus - In-memory menu catalog to resolve order items.
      Returns:
      List of orders currently stored in persistence.

    • getDailyRevenue

      public double getDailyRevenue()
      Calculates daily revenue from all PAID orders created today. Sums order items (price * quantity) where the order status is PAID and the creation date matches today's date.
      Returns:
      Total revenue from today's paid orders, or 0 if none exist.
